scope: Synthetic cooled workstation fixture with a real recorded Meta extension response. Not a live end-to-end design benchmark.

design_run.instruction: Add a camera inspection arm to this workstation with its refrigerated bay. Keep the current deck and racks unchanged, choose compact practical link lengths, and inspect the sample rack from above.

assumptions: Base joint at (220,500) in XZ plane
Targets include x +/-20mm at same z
Arm operates in horizontal plane atop mast
proposal.rationale: Two 320mm links give 640mm max reach covering 629mm farthest sample-rack target with minimal margin; symmetric links keep IK simple and compact while satisfying abs(L1-L2)<=distance<=L1+L2 for all three targets.

checks.detail: All illustrated targets are reachable by planar inverse kinematics.
checks.label: planar reach

checks.detail: The fixed sidecar pad stays within the base width.
checks.label: sidecar width

checks.detail: Recorded pose envelopes respect the available width.
checks.label: workspace width

design_run.message: Inspection arm and camera added to this project. Kinematic concept only; hardware and camera coverage are unverified.
